<?php

use Example\Model\Product;

function page(?int $limit): Product
{
    $page = (new Product())->addAllColumns();
    $conditions = 0;
    if ($limit !== null) {
        $page = $conditions === 0 ? $page->gtPrice($limit) : $page->andGtPrice($limit);
        $conditions++;
    }
    if ($limit !== null) {
        $page = $conditions === 0 ? $page->ltPrice($limit) : $page->andLtPrice($limit);
    }
    return $page;
}

php.example/example.php:
<?php

use Example\Model\Brand;
use Example\Model\Product;

$row = (new Product())->relation((new Brand())->matchBrandSeqWithSeq()->aliasStore());
$row->getStore();

function productCount()
{
    $row = (new Brand())->relations((new Product())->matchSeqWithBrandSeq());
    return $row->getProductModels();
}

function read(array $blocks, bool $flag): void
{
    $row = new Brand();
    [$row] = $blocks;
    $row->getName();
    if ($flag) {
        $row = new Product();
    } else {
        $row = $blocks[0];
    }
    $row->getName();
}

function own(): void
{
    $row = new Product();
    $row->getName();
}
